risks.risk: The actual physical condition (rust, cracks in rubber, or dirt) is hidden by the stock photo.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of the actual item being sold.

risks.risk: Air leaks in the tubing or a damaged diaphragm would make the tool useless for diagnostics.
risks.proof: A video of the stethoscope being used to listen to a mechanical sound.

Close-up photos of the actual diaphragm and earpieces to check for wear or damage.

response.reason: The seller has provided a stock marketing image instead of a photo of the actual item. It is impossible to verify the condition, authenticity, or existence of the goods from this image.
